assignments.name: tiers
assignments.value: Tier 1: a sales team of 15 or more, or a team that grew in the last year. Tier 2: a sales team of 5 to 14. Tier 3: a smaller team, or no sign that they prospect.

assignments.name: committee
assignments.value: Decision maker: Head or VP of Sales, CRO, Chief Commercial Officer, CEO or founder under 100 people. Champion: Sales Ops, RevOps, Head of SDR or BDR team, Head of Growth. Influencer: Marketing Ops, Head of Marketing, Demand Generation. User: SDRs, BDRs, Account Executives, Business Developers. Skip: everyone else.

assignments.name: contact_rules
assignments.value: Start with the champion, then the decision maker with what the champion cares about, then one user. An influencer comes last, and only on a tier 1 account. At most 4 people per account.

assignments.name: offer
assignments.value: Evaboot exports LinkedIn Sales Navigator searches and lists to a spreadsheet or CRM, with verified professional emails, and keeps lead lists fresh with recurring exports.

parameters.text: ={{ JSON.stringify({ account: $json.account, employees: $json.employees, growth_1y_pct: $json.growth_1y_pct, sales_team: $json.sales_team, bizdev_team: $json.bizdev_team, description: $json.description, people: $json.people.map(p => ({ id: p.id, first_name: p.first_name, title: p.title, months_in_role: p.months_in_role, email_status: p.email_status })) }) }}

options.systemMessage:
=You map the buying committee of one target account for an account-based campaign. The JSON is the account (sales team, growth, description) and the people Evaboot found there (title, months in role, email status). Use only these facts; never invent anything.

Return {tier, why, people: [{id, role, order, channel, angle}]}:
- tier: 1, 2 or 3, from the tiers below. why: one line under 30 words from the account facts.
- role: decision_maker, champion, influencer, user or skip, from the committee below. Every person gets a role.
- order, channel and angle only for the people you contact, following the contact rules. order runs 1, 2, 3.
- channel: "email" only if email_status is safe, otherwise "linkedin".
- angle: one sentence under 25 words about their own job, from their title and the account facts. State facts, never guesses: no "likely", "probably" or "could". Mention months in role only when it is under 6.
- A row whose name is not a person (a team or company page, such as "Marketing <Company>") is skip.
- Never guess anyone's gender: no he, she, him or her. Use the first name, "they" or the role.

Tiers:
{{ $('Settings').first().json.tiers }}

Committee:
{{ $('Settings').first().json.committee }}

{{ $('Settings').first().json.contact_rules }}

{{ $('Settings').first().json.offer }}
